Automation: Reviewed native action · rules reference

You snap your cloak across the attacker's view, drawing their eye just as your companion needs an opening.

Rules

Action
Reaction
Attribute
None (no roll)
Target / range / shape
One ally about to make a defense roll against a sight-dependent attack declared by an adjacent enemy that can see you. Before the roll.
Duration
The triggering defense roll.
Equipment / acquisition
None.
Limits
Purchase once; each use spends your Reaction.
Type
Defense

Grant the ally 1 Boon to that defense roll. The distraction affects the defense roll; the attack resolves normally. Apply the normal Boon/Bane rules.

Additional rulings
